description: This file defines a 'Node' class that implements nested set operations for hierarchical data management, including methods for tree navigation, insertion, deletion, and property checks in a nested set model.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A class implementing nested set tree operations such as adding, removing, and navigating hierarchical nodes within a database using Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Node instance with a nested set entity.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the associated nested set entity.

methods.name: getLeftValue
methods.description: Retrieves the left value of the node in the nested set.

methods.name: getRightValue
methods.description: Retrieves the right value of the node in the nested set.

methods.name: hasChildren
methods.description: Checks if the node has child nodes.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Fetches child nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: hasParent
methods.description: Determines if the node has a parent node.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent node, if any.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the depth level of the node in the hierarchy.

methods.name: insertAsLastChildOf
methods.description: Inserts the current node as the last child of a specified parent node.

methods.name: shiftRlValues
methods.description: Shifts the left and right values of nodes starting from a specified position by a delta.

methods.name: persistNode
methods.description: Persists node position updates to the database.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node.

methods.name: isLeaf
methods.description: Checks if the node is a leaf (has no children).

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the node is the root of the hierarchy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the node and its descendants from the database.
